content.comment_body: Hello everyone! About a year ago, [user_name] started a thread for wishlist ideas regarding [product_name] and [product_name] software, with various forum members contributing and updating their suggestions. Some of these requests, such as improved networking capabilities mentioned by [user_name] and [user_name], were implemented in [version_no] (though perhaps not by coincidence). Now, I realize that if we compile our suggestions for [version_no], they might be considered for future updates. I’ve attached my wish list for [version_no] (in an excel file). Please feel free to add your own ideas and share them here. Regards,

Thank you for creating this opportunity, [user_name]! It's great that there is still room for improvements in this compact controller, but we should set clear boundaries for its capabilities. As [user_name] mentioned: Let's focus on enhancements to [product_name] hardware without shifting towards more advanced systems like [version_no]. I believe [product_name] stands out, especially after the upgrade in network functions, and it's time to enhance the [product_name] software as well, including new [product_name] HMI features. It’s quite costly to use display panels from other series, so a smaller (4-7 inch) touch display with buttons, simplified SCADA, and dedicated visualization for [product_name]—all within its own software—would be a significant improvement. This would especially help applications like packaging machines and keep costs low. That’s my current perspective. By the way, excellent work on the communication protocols! Best regards
I’d like to see support for adding more than one analog output module. Best [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Forum members are collaborating to share feature requests and suggestions for upcoming [product_name] controller versions, mainly focusing on both hardware and [product_name] software improvements. Users acknowledge recent upgrades like enhanced networking, but are still hoping for advancements in visualization, HMI integration, and modular expansion. The discussion highlights the need for greater adaptability and modern interface options, while keeping solutions budget-friendly for typical [product_name] use cases.
analysis.user_expectations: Forum users anticipate that future [product_name] versions will offer improved visualization features, integrated HMI tailored for [product_name], and support for more expansion modules, all while staying affordable.
